What's new in Eliya Notes 1.6:
• Drag tables anywhere: point at a table, grab the ⠿ handle on its left and drop it wherever you want in the note
• Tables: add rows/columns, merge or split cells, and change cell, row and border colors (right-click a table)
• Draw with the trackpad or mouse (Draw button)
• Boxes (Definition, Tip…) fixed: no more squished boxes, and they keep their color
